input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Developer, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for apisix auto registration, apisix registration, apisix registry. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include API gateway functionality.

user_stories.story: As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Developer, I want to interact with hello functionality, so that I can accomplish my hello-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to use apisix auto registration capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Developer, I want to use apisix registration capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Developer, I want to use apisix registry capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
